correctness.rationale: Starting from Bravyi–Kitaev Eq. (36), exact algebra gives \(f(\epsilon)-\epsilon=r(1-r^2)Q(r^2)/[2(1+15r^8)]\), with \(Q(y)=y^6+y^5+y^4-14y^3+y^2+y+1\). The reciprocal identity \(Q(y)=y^3q(y+y^{-1})\), \(q(z)=z^3+z^2-2z-16\), reduces interior fixed points to one cubic root because \(q(2)=-8\), \(q(3)=14\), and \(q'(z)>0\) for \(z\ge2\). The sign of \(Q\), invariance of the physical interval, and continuity give the complete monotone basin classification.
risks: The theorem is restricted to the source's one-dimensional H-twirled independent-input map.
